title: Context Clues — English for Kids | Mind Blooming
skills: use surrounding text to infer unfamiliar word meanings
identify common types of context clues
confirm inferred meanings using sentence and paragraph context

alignment_note: Provides an accessible review of context-clue strategies for determining the meaning of unfamiliar words from surrounding text. Although designed for younger learners, it can serve as remediation, intervention, multilingual reinforcement, or foundational review within high school English courses.
